proxyDescription: Controls which proxies may supply the real client IP. Incorrect values affect auditing, rate limits, and IP access rules.
trustedProxiesDescription: One per line. Enter only proxies directly in front of EasySSH; never use 0.0.0.0/0.
restartRequired: This value is loaded at startup. Restart EasySSH after saving it.
cookieDescription: Control browser scope for login refresh-token and CSRF cookies.
cookieSecureModeDescription: Auto detects HTTP or HTTPS for each request, so one configuration works locally and on a real domain.
cookieDomainDescription: Usually leave empty to bind the current host. Set only when cookies must be shared across subdomains.
originDescription: CORS controls which frontends may read the API; CSRF trust validates cross-site cookie requests.
corsOriginsDescription: Same-origin requests and the local development URL need no entry. Wildcard * is forbidden with credentials.
csrfOriginsDescription: One full HTTP(S) origin per line, without a path, query, or fragment.
browserPolicyDescription: Restrict allowed sources for scripts, styles, images, connections, and frames.
cspDescription: Leave empty for EasySSH's built-in policy. A custom value applies to subsequent requests immediately.
cspPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the built-in Content-Security-Policy
